title: Ensaio integrado GTKConfig real, observador e recarga GTK2

method.isolation: Bubblewrap com raiz de sistema somente leitura, namespaces privados de PID/rede, ambiente limpo, barramento de sessão próprio e indisponibilidade do barramento de sistema. Diretório de plugins KDED montado com somente gtkconfig.so; plugin SHA-256 45ed5ab79fe42cce6ced85d35f3cc266c7347e28fc9751338bbdab851bd519c9.
method.production_path: theme_companion_bridge.watch() e QProcess worker de produção; runtimes GTK2 e GTK4 de produção. A guarda da sessão hospedeira foi substituída somente no worker isolado, com as raízes HOME/XDG/D-Bus/DISPLAY verificadas.
method.trigger: Alteração do papel Colors:Window/BackgroundNormal no kdeglobals privado e emissão do sinal nativo org.kde.kconfig.notify.ConfigChanged. O módulo GTKConfig real exportou a paleta e o observador acionou os runtimes.

source_review.finding: GtkConfig::setGtkTheme writes GTK3/4 SettingsIniEditor; the GTK2 ~/.gtkrc-2.0 path is handled by Gtk2ConfigEditor separately.

result.cleanup: GTK2/GTK4 palette state and private companion bundle were restored in the isolated profile; all namespace processes were terminated.

limitation.full_observer_worker: The worker exits nonzero after the GTK2 update, in the subsequent GTK4 refresh. GTK4 refresh temporarily requests the -Reload theme and verifies every GTK selection file, including ~/.gtkrc-2.0. The installed GTKConfig setGtkTheme updates GTK3/4 settings.ini but does not rewrite the GTK2 rc file for that temporary GTK4 suffix. The observer therefore logs a failed synchronization even though GTK2 rendered the new palette.
limitation.scope: Recorded as an adjacent integration defect only; no GTK4 production code was changed because the active authorized family is GTK2.
limitation.historical_visual: Synthetic GTK2 fixture verifies dynamic palette propagation, not SR10.4 Motif fidelity. The native VM comparison remains pending.

attempts.outcome: harness failed because the private worker did not bypass the host-session guard; no product changes.
harness environment inherited host session variables and failed its isolation assertion; corrected with a cleared Bubblewrap environment.
real GTKConfig and GTK2 palette rendered; the subsequent out-of-scope GTK4 refresh failed as described.
